correctness.rationale: Reconstructed RESULT.md:53–100. The derivative of the truncated Gaussian probability is the covariance with U divided by σ², strictly negative even at the endpoints because both conditional means exist and are strictly ordered. With the replete-first phenotype convention, the three HL payoff gaps are p d(q), d(q), ω d(q), uniformly at least κ>0. Replicator log-ratios, treating zero initial frequencies as invariant, give exactly the stated C e^(−κt) bound. The resource remains interior at all finite times by bounded logit drift. Because q=p x+ω y, both x and 1−y are bounded by 1−z_HL and |q−ω| is as well; the residual in the full scalar resource drift is therefore exponentially small, not assumed zero. Outside each neighborhood of the selected scalar equilibrium the eventual logit drift has the required strict inward sign, with magnitude bounded below on each nonempty side, giving entry and trapping, including either equality. At F(0)=0 the inequality for v=1/n is v′≤K+B e^(−κt)v; the integrating factor is bounded above and away from zero and gives v=O(1+t). This makes the transient error divided by n vanish, so v′ tends to ε(1+θ)(−ω′(0)); averaging v′ gives the first limit. For the other equality, the equation for w=1−n replaces F by −F(1−w) and the error by its negative, giving the second limit with the same positive sign. Strict decrease rules out simultaneous critical equalities. This also excludes nonconstant recurrent trajectories on the stated domain, not on faces missing HL. The supporting verify.py and recorded output were inspected, not rerun: the rational check uses one payoff quadruple and the numerical integration samples only the lower critical threshold. Neither is required for the analytic conclusion.

value.rationale: Closes a specific gap between observed and proved global behavior for a published resource-feedback model. It identifies the resource outcome throughout the stated initial-state domain and quantifies precisely how the resource can decay only algebraically at a threshold while phenotype fixation is exponential. The transient estimate makes the critical constants valid independently of the initial mixture, not only on the pure-strategy invariant edge.
